title: Night Radio
desc: A few lines written late at night.
body:
The radio crackles in the small hours, like someone gently knocking on a door far away.

I think everyone carries a lighthouse inside — dark most days, lighting up only on certain nights, for whoever happens to be passing.

bodyZh:
凌晨的電台沙沙作響，像有人在很遠的地方輕輕敲門。

我想每個人心裡都有一座燈塔——大部分日子是暗的，只在某些夜晚亮起來，給剛好路過的人看。

title: About Koyome
desc: What this little site is for.
body:
Koyome (koyome.me) is a small plot of internet to call my own:

· keeping the words worth keeping
· storing the pictures worth revisiting
· archiving the videos worth watching again

No chasing trends — only collecting signals.
bodyZh:
Koyome（koyome.me）是我在網路上的一小塊地：

· 留下值得留下的字
· 存放值得回頭看的圖
· 收藏值得再看一次的影像

不追什麼潮流——只是收集訊號。
